The door is tightly locked...\n[ffff64]*You can enter this map by proceeding Mission.[ffffff]
The door is tightly locked...
Unlock with Tomb Key
Oh, it's you... We were beaten...\nThe enemy was too strong...
Hey, are you alright?! What happened...?\n!! You were attacked by someone?!
We're starving... We can't move...
P-perhaps the enemy was strong...\nBut nobody can win when hungry.
We heard that someone attacked the soldiers\nso we came here to find the culprit...
As I investigate the incident we found that all\nthe victims have something in common.\nThey use axes.
So, I tried to decoy the culprit,\nbut I ran out of food...
We agreed to go back once\nbut we're too hungry to move...
*sigh* ...You guys got no brain, right?\nWere you waiting for the culprit till you become\nhungry...?
Keep doing that and your adventure is gonna be\na one-way trip to hell.
My bad...
I feel ashamed...
Well, okay.\nJust a minute.
Hmm... Hm, alright.\nI can make a special meal for you!
...Hey, come on.\nI need these ingredients.\nAlright?
You looked at the list but...\nNone of them sounds like food...
No worries! Trust me.\nOh, especially, do not forget this one, okay?
It says [Sand Mole Meat x1]....
It may sound like food but...\nAnyway, let's go collect them.
Thanks! But you need to hurry, okay?
So, that's Sand Mole.\nBut it doesn't look like a mole at all...
Finished?
Wow, great!!\nAlright, I'll cook them.
A horrible noise that doesn't sound like someone's\ncooking can be heard from where Pelulu is...
? What's wrong?\n...Huh? It doesn't look like I'm cooking?
How rude...\nIt's a special meal for Cules, you know?
We know how to cook everything right.
We learn from our ancestors who lived a hard life.\nYou'll see!
*munch* How... How tasty it is!\n*munch* It's the best meal I've ever had!
Nom nom nom... Indeed!\nYou collected the ingredients for us, right?\n*gulp* Thanks for helping us.
Take your time eating.\nThere's more, so just help yourself.
They'd never want to know what they're eating...
Hey, did you see a strange person in the highland?\n...Okay. Why don't we report it to the leader?
I'll put the food right there. We'll leave first.\nYou guys should go back to the city after you\nfinish eating it.
Yea. Thanks.
Thanks for helping us.\nWatch your steps...
Thanks! But you need to hurry, okay?
